title: Alien reproduction vehicles exist and are stored at known sites
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Alien reproduction vehicles exist and are stored at known sites, about present at unspecified storage sites, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, I mean, I can just say that they exist. Okay. And I know where some of them are stored at, but that's about it.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a guest named Michael Herrera talks about "alien reproduction vehicles", meaning craft said to be built by people by copying alien technology. Herrera says, passing on what he was told, that these craft exist and that he knows where some of them are stored, though he gives no more than that. If true, it would mean someone has already copied alien machines and is keeping them hidden.
